fieldNotes.truckGate: Site is enclosed by chain-link perimeter fencing (visible in Street View 2025-06 along Centerville Road). A single wide truck driveway curves off Centerville Road into the truck yard - a controlled entry point.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard-booth structure visible at the entrance driveway in zoom-20/21 satellite. The standalone structure on the SW farmland is a barn/silo, not a guard shack.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true - there is a controlled fenced gate but no staffed guard booth, implying kiosk/remote check-in. Medium confidence; left in uncertainFields.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Massive single warehouse (~500 m long) with continuous dock-door banks and trailers backed in on multiple faces - well into the 50+ band. Largest single CJ DC in roster (1,138,364 sq ft per Racklify).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks run along multiple separate building faces (SW long face and NE long face), consistent with separate ship/receive clusters.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Extensive trailer drop yards at the SE end and along the building faces; 150+ trailers parked across the imagery.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entrance apron and substantial paved truck-court width provide room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Surrounded by open farmland in rural Cumberland County PA - clearly rural.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur visible entering the property; building is highway-served (adjacent to a multi-lane highway, US-11 corridor).
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single shared entry/exit driveway; lane split not resolvable from imagery.
